description: Save the named window arrangement as a workspace. Legacy name kept for older clients — new integrations should call save_workspace, which can also record whether running apps get moved into place. Omit 'items' to snapshot the windows exactly as they are on screen right now; pass 'items' to describe the arrangement explicitly. Saving over an existing name replaces it. Saved workspaces are listed in get_state, with their full contents.

app.description: App name to match, e.g. 'Safari', 'Visual Studio Code'

title.description: Only windows whose title contains this substring

name: save_layout
